title: Fragment archive, version 1
description: A fragment's built folder as one JSON document: every file by its relative path, as text, and the content hash of those files.

$schema.description: The URL or path of this schema; its file name carries the version.

hash.description: sha256: and the lowercase hex SHA-256 of the UTF-8 JSON text of [[path, text], ...], sorted by path (JavaScript string order).

files.description: The files by relative POSIX path (no leading slash, no . or .. segments, no backslash), as UTF-8 text.
